tools.name: get_pricing_and_limits
tools.description: Returns current FastScribe prices, credit rules, free allowances, upload and link limits, supported inputs and export formats. No account needed.

tools.name: transcribe_url
tools.description: Transcribes a public YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X/Twitter, Facebook video from its URL and returns the transcript. Spends credits from the user's FastScribe balance (see get_pricing_and_limits). Private or restricted videos fail and are not charged.

tools.name: get_transcript
tools.description: Returns a finished transcript from the user’s FastScribe account as plain text, timestamped text or SRT.

tools.name: list_transcripts
tools.description: Lists the most recent transcription jobs in the user’s FastScribe account with their IDs and status.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_transcript, list_transcripts · Private data: transcribe_url · Public sink: get_pricing_and_limits.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_transcript, list_transcripts · Private data: transcribe_url · Public sink: get_pricing_and_limits

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
